settings.title:
Every shipping order
on one platform

settings.editor: Enviar Solutions brings your shipping orders, carriers, tracking and billing into one place. Your team gets complete visibility while we handle the operational complexity behind every delivery.
PLATFORM

From perishable goods and everyday freight to cash deliveries, Tuma brings every shipment together on a single, unified logistics platform. Gain complete visibility, streamline operations, and stay in control—without the complexity of managing logistics.

settings.description_text: Bring shipping orders from every carrier and courier into one dashboard. No more switching between portals, spreadsheets or email threads.
Combine eligible shipments and select the right route and carrier for every order, reducing cost and operational complexity.
Replace multiple carrier invoices with one consolidated monthly statement, reconciled and ready for your finance team.
Follow every shipment in real time across all carriers, with proactive alerts when something needs your attention.
Understand logistics spend, carrier performance, delivery times and savings through clear operational dashboards.
Hand off the operational load entirely. We manage carriers, routing and exceptions so your team can focus on production and sales.

settings.editor: LOGISTICS CAPABILITIES

settings.title: Built for the way modern logistics works

settings.editor: From order intake to delivery reporting, Tuma gives your team one clear view of every shipment while Enviar manages the coordination behind the scenes.
TRACKING & CONTROL
Monitor active deliveries, status updates, delays and exceptions from one operational view.
OPERATIONS
Assign the right carrier, manage routes and keep delivery responsibilities clear.
FINANCE
Replace multiple carrier invoices with one reconciled monthly statement.
FULFILMENT
Coordinate pickups, stock movement and delivery handovers with better visibility.
INSIGHTS
Understand delivery times, carrier performance, logistics spend and service outcomes.
HOW IT WORKS

settings.title: From scattered orders to fully managed logistics

settings.editor: Four steps to hand off the operational weight of shipping while keeping complete visibility and control.
01
Get set up in minutes. Our carrier and courier network is already live on Enviar Solutions, so your team starts creating orders right away.
02
Enviar Solutions aggregates orders, combines eligible shipments, and dispatches each one through the most efficient option.
03
Monitor every shipment in real time with unified status, exceptions handled by our managed operations team.
04
Receive a single reconciled statement each month, with analytics showing exactly where you saved.
